title: verdict-diff
description: The concrete five-field diff between an original run's verdict and a rematch (src/rematch.js + src/cli.js --rematch) or replay (--replay) of the same task, produced by src/verdict-diff.js's computeVerdictDiff(). Shared verbatim by both consumers - see the module header.

signoff_match.description: True if both reports' top-level `passed` boolean agree.

verdict_category_changed.description: True if the two reports' outcome() classification ('consensus'/'no_consensus'/'degraded') differ.

critics_objecting_added.description: Seat-role ids (positional, e.g. 'critic-0') that objected in the new report but not the original. Positional because a rematch/replay changes which model backs each seat.

critics_objecting_removed.description: Seat-role ids that objected in the original report but not the new one.

objection_overlap_ratio.description: Exact-string-match dedupe overlap (Jaccard) between the two reports' objection texts - 1 when both sides raised the identical set of objection texts, or both raised none.
